$comment: Bare strings in a source .chiplet (format 1.1, the one exception to validation rule 7; docs/CHIPLET_FORMAT_SPEC.md). A string value goes bare when it matches PATTERN and its lowercased form is not in RETYPED_WORDS; everything else is quoted. Each case is one dies item line. 'refuse': a source reader refuses the bare value on that line and gives WRITE, the same line with the value quoted; 'reads_as' is what a YAML 1.1 loader (PyYAML) makes of the bare value, which is why it cannot go bare ('str' where only the rule refuses it). 'accept': no finding. conformance/test_source_bare_strings.py proves the file against the spec text and PyYAML; description/ runs every case through its source reader. Add a case here, never in a consumer.
